```{r}
#| label: Load libraries
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsegGlasser)
library(ggseg)
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(afex)
library(emmeans)

# Load utility functions
source("R/plotting.R")
```

```{r}
#| label: Load data and specify fixed effects formula
setwd("../data_tidy/")

frame <- readRDS("gradients.RDS")
fixed_effects <- "group + age + sex + site"
```

Projection of 7 functional networks defined by Yeo et al. on ROIs defined by Glasser et al.

```{r}
#| label: Plot yeo networks
dt_yeo <- frame %>%
  dplyr::distinct(region, yeo, hemi)

cmap_yeo <- c(
  visual = "#781286", 
  sensorimotor = "#4682B4", 
  'dorsal attention' = "#00760E", 
  'ventral attention' = "#C43AFA",
  limbic = "#DCF8A4", 
  frontoparietal = "#E69422", 
  'default mode' = "#CD3E4E"
)

dt_yeo$yeo <- plyr::revalue(dt_yeo$yeo, c(
  "VN" = "visual", 
  "SMN" = "sensorimotor", 
  "DAN" = "dorsal attention",
  "VAN" = "ventral attention",
  "LN" = "limbic",
  "FPN" = "frontoparietal",
  "DMN" = "default mode"
))

dt_yeo$yeo <- factor(dt_yeo$yeo, levels = names(cmap_yeo))

yeo_plot <- ggplot(data = dt_yeo) +
  geom_brain(
    atlas = glasser(),
    position = position_brain(view + hemi ~ ., views = c("lateral", "medial")),
    aes(fill = yeo),
    size = 0.05
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cmap_yeo, name = "") +
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.25, 'cm'))

print(yeo_plot)
```

Distribution of gradient values across G1 and G2 in the groups of blind and sighted individuals.

# Connectivity gradients across neocortex

## ROI analyses

```{r paged.print = FALSE}
stats_lm <- frame %>%
  group_by(region, hemi, yeo, gradient, stream) %>%
  do({
    model <- lm(as.formula(paste("gradient_score ~", fixed_effects)), data = .)
    tidy(model) %>%
      filter(grepl("^group", term)) # Extract group coefficient
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(
    coefficient = estimate,
    statistic = statistic
  )

# Apply FDR correction per gradient
stats_corrected <- stats_lm %>%
  group_by(gradient) %>%
  mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(p_adjust < 0.05)

# extract min and max for plotting
min_val <- min(stats_corrected$statistic)
max_val <- max(stats_corrected$statistic)

stats_g1 <- stats_corrected %>%
  dplyr::filter(gradient == "gradient_1") %>%
  arrange(yeo, stream) %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3) %>%
  mutate(across(c(p.value, p_adjust), ~ ifelse(. < 0.001, "< 0.001", as.character(.)))) %>%
  select(-gradient, -term) %>%
  rename("p (uncorr)" = p.value, "p (corr)" = p_adjust) 

write.csv(stats_g1, "../results/table_s01.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

### Gradient 1

```{r}
# We use the original data for plotting, just for visualization purposes
sum_group <- frame[, .(mean_grad = mean(gradient_score, na.rm = TRUE)),
                     by = .(group, yeo, region, gradient, hemi, stream)]

gradient1_df <- sum_group %>%
  filter(gradient == "gradient_1") %>%
  group_by(group)

g1_plot3 <-
  ggplot(gradient1_df) +
  geom_brain(atlas = glasser(),
             position = position_brain(. ~ hemi + view, views = c("lateral", "medial")),
             aes(fill = mean_grad)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("blue", "grey", "red"),
                       name = "gradient\nscore") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm")) +
  theme(legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12, family = "Calibri Light")) +
  facet_grid(factor(group, levels = c("SC", "CB")) ~., switch = "y")
g1_plot3
```

Results of the region-wise comparison of the gradient scores between groups of sighted and blind individuals (results were corrected for multiple comparisons with FDR at p \< .05).

```{r}
group_diff_g1_plot3 <- create_diff_plot3(stats_g1, min_val, max_val, "Gradient 1")
group_diff_g1_plot3
```

## Community-based profiles

To summarise the findings from the ROI analysis, we applied a well-established functional community decomposition (see Methods). Then we conducted a network-based z-score analysis of gradient scores for each of the first three gradients.

### Gradient 1

Distribution of the gradient scores for each of the 7 functional networks (transparent distribution: group of blind individuals, non-transparent distribution: group of sighted controls). The tick below the density plots represents the mean gradient score.

```{r}
sum_community <- frame[, .(mean_grad = median(gradient_score)),
                         by = .(subject, group, yeo, gradient, age, sex, site)]

gradient_1 <- sum_community[gradient == "gradient_1", ]

grad1_plot <- create_dist_plot(gradient_1)
grad1_plot
```

Results of the network-based z-score analysis of gradient scores.

```{r paged.print = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sum_community <- frame[, .(mean_grad = mean(gradient_score)), 
                         by = .(subject, group, yeo, gradient, age, sex, site)]

community_g1 <- sum_community[gradient == "gradient_1", ]

model1 <- mixed(as.formula(paste("mean_grad ~ yeo * ", fixed_effects, "+ (1|subject)")), data = community_g1)
model1

```

```{r paged.print=FALSE}
emm_int <- emmeans(model1, ~ group | yeo)

emm_int_df <- summary(emm_int) %>%
  data.table() %>%
  dplyr::mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 3)
emm_int_df

setwd("../results")
write.csv(emm_int_df, "table_s04.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r paged.print=FALSE}
post_emm_int <- update(pairs(emm_int), adjust = "holm")
post_df <- data.table(summary(post_emm_int))
post_emm_int <- summary(post_emm_int) %>%
  data.table()  %>%
  dplyr::mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 3)
post_emm_int

setwd("../results")
write.csv(post_emm_int, "table_s05.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
grad1_lolli_plot <- create_lolli_plot(post_emm_int, t.ratio, yeo, cmap_yeo)
grad1_lolli_plot
```

## Between-network distances

### Gradient 1

LMM Results

```{r}
# Calculate the mean gradient for yeo == "VN" for each subject and group
vn_means <- gradient_1 %>%
  filter(yeo == "VN") %>%
  group_by(subject, group) %>%
  summarise(vn_mean_grad = mean(mean_grad, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Join the means with the original dataframe
vn_distance <- gradient_1 %>%
  group_by(subject, group, yeo, site, age, sex) %>%
  summarise(mean_grad = mean(mean_grad, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  left_join(vn_means, by = c("subject", "group")) %>%
  mutate(diff_vn = abs(mean_grad - vn_mean_grad)) %>%
  filter(yeo != "VN") %>%
  ungroup()

model1 <- mixed(as.formula(paste("diff_vn ~ yeo * ", fixed_effects, "+ (1|subject)")), data = vn_distance)
model1
```

Estimated marginal means

```{r paged.print=FALSE}
emm_int <- emmeans(model1, ~ group | yeo)

emm_int_df <- summary(emm_int) %>%
  data.table() %>%
  dplyr::mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 3)
emm_int_df

setwd("../results")
write.csv(emm_int_df, "table_s10.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

Post-hoc tests



# Figure 2

```{r}
cowplot::set_null_device(cairo_pdf)

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(grad_plot12 +
                                theme(legend.title = element_blank()))

first_row <-
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    yeo_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"),
    legend,
    grad_plot12 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
    NULL,
    grad_plot13 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
    labels = c("A", "", "B", "", "C"),
    label_size = 8,
    rel_widths = c(0.25, 0.25, 1, 0.05, 1),
    ncol = 5
  )

legend <- cowplot::get_plot_component(group_diff_g1_plot3, "guide-box-bottom", return_all = TRUE)

second_row <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  group_diff_g1_plot3 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  group_diff_g2_plot3 + theme(legend.position = "none"), 
  group_diff_g3_plot3 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  labels = c("D", "E", "F"),
  label_size = 8,
  hjust = 0,
  ncol = 3
  )

third_row <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  NULL,
  legend,
  NULL,
  ncol = 3,
  rel_widths = c(1,1,1)
)

all_figs <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  first_row,
  second_row,
  third_row,
  rel_heights = c(1, 1, 0.25),
  ncol = 1,
  align = "v"
)

setwd("../figures")

ggsave(
  all_figs,
  filename = "figure_2.pdf",
  device = cairo_pdf,
  height = 10,
  width = 16.5,
  units = "cm",
  bg = "transparent",
  dpi = "print"
)

tiff(
  "figure_2.tiff",
  height = 10,
  width = 16.5,
  units = "cm",
  compression = "lzw",
  res = 500,
  type = "cairo",
  bg = "white"
)
all_figs
dev.off()
```

```{r}
  rel_widths = c(1.5, 1, 1),
  rel_heights = c(0.15, 1, 0.15, 1, 0.15, 1, 0.15),
  ncol = 3
  )

setwd("../figures")

cowplot::set_null_device(cairo_pdf)
ggsave(
  third_row,
  filename = "figure_3.pdf",
  device = cairo_pdf,
  height = 18,
  width = 15,
  units = "cm",
  bg = "transparent",
  dpi = "print"
)

tiff(
  "figure_3.tiff",
  height = 18,
  width = 15,
  units = "cm",
  compression = "lzw",
  res = 500,
  type = "cairo",
  bg = "white"
)
print(third_row)
dev.off()
```

# Figure S2

```{r}
roi_df <- frame %>% 
  select(region, yeo, stream) %>%
  mutate(is_roi = ifelse(is.na(stream), "no", "yes")) %>%
  mutate(roi = ifelse(!is.na(stream), region, NA)) %>%
  distinct()

roi_plot <- ggplot(data = roi_df) +
  geom_brain(atlas = glasser(),
             position = position_brain(view ~ hemi),
             aes(fill = is_roi),
             size = 0.1) +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey", "red")) +
  theme(legend.title=element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.25, 'cm')) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

setwd("../figures")

cowplot::set_null_device(cairo_pdf)
ggsave(
  roi_plot,
  filename = "figure_s2.pdf",
  device = cairo_pdf,
  height = 7.5,
  width = 10,
  units = "cm",
  bg = "transparent",
  dpi = "print"
)

tiff(
  "figure_s2.tiff",
  height = 7.5,
  width = 10,
  units = "cm",
  compression = "lzw",
  res = 500,
  type = "cairo",
  bg = "white"
)
dev.off()

```
